Data Normalization¶

        _____________________________________________________________________
        -   Not Normalised              |               Normalised 
        _____________________________________________________________________
        Age         |   SALARY          |       Age |    SALARY 
        30          |   4,00,000        |     0.3   |   1
        40          |   60,000          |     0.4   |   0.15
        50          |   3,00,000        |     0.5   |   0.75
        _____________________________________________________________________

                                      METHODS 
                                        |
    SIMPLE FEATURES SCALING        MAX-MIN       Z-SCORE/STANDARD SCORE
  • SIMPLE FEATURES SCALING METHODS
    • Mathematically,
      • x base new = x base old / x base max

      • Result range : 0 to 1

  • MIN-MAX METHODS

    • Mathematically
      • x base = x base old - x base min / x base max - x base min

      • Result range : 0 to 1

  • Z - SCORE / STANDARD SCORE METHODS

    • Mathematically,
      • x base new = x base old = mu / sigma

      • Result range : -3 t0 +3

  • ANOVA¶

      • Analysis of Variance

        • Statistical Comparison of groups
        • Finding the correlation between Groups
        1. MAIN PARAMETERS

        • F- TEST SCORE: Ratio of vartiation between the groups mean over the variation within the sample groups

        • P -Value: Checks for the significance .

      • Example

Correlation¶

    • Measures to what extent different variables are interdependent .
      • E.G:
        • Lung Cancer -> SMOKING
      1. Pearson Correlation
      • Correlation Co-Efficient
      • P-VALUE
    • Correlation Co-Efficient
      • Close To +1:
        • Large positive Relationship
      • Close To -1:
        • Large Negtive Relationship
      • Close To 0:

        • No Relationship

        • P - Value

¶

    _________________________________________________________
    S.No        |       Value               | Result 
    _________________________________________________________
    1.              <0.001                      STRONG
    2.              <0.05                       MODERATE 
    3.              <0.1                        WEAK
    4.              >0.1                        NO CERTAINTY 
    _________________________________________________________
    • Strong Correlation
      • Correlation Coefficient = +1 & -1
      • P - Value = <0.001
